title: Exceptional Sign Pairs in Oscillatory Asymptotics and Conjectures of Andrews
summary: In this paper, we prove an \emph{exceptional sign pair phenomenon} for a general family of integer sequences with exponentially growing oscillatory asymptotics. This resolves, in particular, conjectural sign patterns proposed by Andrews in a 1986 paper for three $q$-series from Ramanujan's Lost Notebook, namely $v_2(q), v_3(q),$ and $v_4(q)$. Recent work of Kundu, Storzer, Wang, and the author established that the coefficients of these $q$-series are alternating in sign except in a density-zero set.
